description: This file defines the 'User' class within the Opencart system, specifically related to cart functionality. The class manages user session data, authentication (login/logout), permission checks, and user information retrieval in an e-commerce platform.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Manages user session, authentication, and permissions within the cart system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes user object, loads user data if session exists.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates user with username and password, updates session and permissions.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears user session data and resets internal user info.

methods.name: hasPermission
methods.description: Checks if user has specific permission for a given key and value.

methods.name: isLogged
methods.description: Returns whether the user is currently logged in.
